Rebates and other income are listed separately; unsettled valuations are excluded. The official API may spread daily historical samples across an hourly grid, so amounts reflect its sampling method and are not an exact per-trade settlement ledger. The trader's cumulative figure covers their full wallet history; ours starts with this task. Daily fees are shown for reference and are already included in net P&L; do not deduct them again.
